headline: Delayed deliveries push profit down and net result to a loss
summary_short: Hanwha Aerospace reported Q3 consolidated revenue of ₩6.09T, down 6% y/y, and operating profit of ₩452B, down 46%, with EPS of -₩2,627.
summary_long: Press reports say the company swung to a net loss because of delayed weapons deliveries and one-off costs. Ground defense revenue was ₩1.25T with operating profit of ₩21.7B. The order backlog was reported at ₩35T at the end of September.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit are from Korean press coverage of the Oct. 29, 2026 results; EPS and its comparisons are from the shard. Reported date on the shard is Nov. 12; the summary uses the Oct. 29 results date.
